notes.title: Update 6/21/2017
notes.content:
-Added gamepad controls, with an auto-aim option available.
-Gave Christie the ability to roll in the air.
-Added bosses to the world map to show which stages are complete.
-Removed the swapping time for weapons, they'll now swap instantly.
-A few other bug fixes!
